notes: Per-model list prices used to MODEL a cost per run from provider-reported token usage and search operations. Every rate ships null until the operator pastes current vendor prices here (or sets BEACON_AI_PRICING_OVERRIDES_JSON with the same shape). A null rate means estimated_cost is UNAVAILABLE for that model; Beacon never guesses a dollar figure. Keys are provider:model. Rates: input_per_1m / cached_input_per_1m / output_per_1m are USD per one million tokens; search_call_per_1k is USD per one thousand web-search tool calls; grounded_prompt_per_1k is USD per one thousand grounded prompts (Gemini-style grounding billing).
